Tomato Blight.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation to keep leaves dry and maintain proper crop spacing for airflow.
Tomato Blight.treatment: Spray copper-based fungicide. Remove infected lower leaves immediately and ensure adequate spacing for airflow.
Tomato Blight.care: Avoid watering foliage directly for 24 hours after fungicide application. Add organic compost to rebuild plant strength and inspect daily.
